title: Deer
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#c8813a'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='16' ry='8' fill='#f2d2a0'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#a5652a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8f5522'/>
  <rect x='56' y='82' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#a5652a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#8f5522'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='60' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f2d2a0'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='44' width='14' height='18' rx='6' fill='#c8813a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#c8813a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='28' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#a5652a' transform='rotate(-25 34 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='28' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#a5652a' transform='rotate(25 66 28)'/>
  <!-- inner ear -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='29' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#f2d2a0' transform='rotate(-25 35 29)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='29' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#f2d2a0' transform='rotate(25 65 29)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M42 26 L36 12 L30 16' fill='none' stroke='#e0b060' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M40 22 L42 14' fill='none' stroke='#e0b060' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 26 L64 12 L70 16' fill='none' stroke='#e0b060' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M60 22 L58 14' fill='none' stroke='#e0b060' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#f2d2a0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5a2e10'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='3' fill='#3a1a08'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='36' r='3' fill='#3a1a08'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 46 Q50 49 54 46' fill='none' stroke='#8f5522' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- white tail spots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='66' r='2' fill='#f2d2a0'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='72' r='2' fill='#f2d2a0'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='72' r='2' fill='#f2d2a0'/>
</svg>
